Because their time frame for defuelling and sort of having a new concept of operations for fuels is only a year. So by the time there's a new governor or at least by the time she or he has a new AG and all the rest of it, that should not be something that has to be used for leverage because we should be Paul, right? So it's not, I mean, I'm still going to fight for it. But when something's not in the president's budget, that means I have to fight like hell to get it into the final budget. But it's proposed by the executive branch. It's not that I have to do nothing, but I have to do a fair amount less. because there's alignment. And so I think we're pretty close to 100% alignment.
